description_excerpt: Job Description We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical MEP Engineer to join our team in Đông Ngạc, Vietnam. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, coordinating, and overseeing mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems for various construction and building projects. You will work collaboratively with architects, contractors, and other engineering professionals to ensure all MEP systems are efficiently integrated, compliant with building codes, and delivered on schedule.
